mean.mae_protocol: Mean absolute error over 705 cells masked at random (15%) from 1500 fully-observed rows; identical cells for all three methods.
mean.description: Global mean substitution (CO(GT) baseline 2.15 mg/m³, MAE 1.04 mg/m³). Fast computation O(1), but severely dampens temporal variance and fails to capture rush-hour dynamics.

median.mae_protocol: Mean absolute error over 705 cells masked at random (15%) from 1500 fully-observed rows; identical cells for all three methods.
median.description: Median substitution (CO(GT) baseline 1.80 mg/m³, MAE 1.04 mg/m³). Resistant to extreme pollution outlier spikes, but creates flatline artifacts in sensor telemetry.

knn.mae_protocol: Mean absolute error over 705 cells masked at random (15%) from 1500 fully-observed rows; identical cells for all three methods.
knn.description: K-Nearest Neighbors (k=5) based on multi-sensor atmospheric proximity (PT08.S1, C6H6, NOx, Temperature). Reconstructs smooth diurnal curves with 0.28 mg/m³ MAE on CO(GT).
